raw_segments.text: Us two being now alone, resumed Joe, and me having the intentions and abilities to stay
not many minutes more, I will now conclude. Leastways begin, to mention what have led
to my having had the present honor. For was it not, said Joe, with his old air of lucid
exposition, that my only wish were to be useful to you, I should not have had the honor of
breaking whittles in the company and abode of gentlemen.
